verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal is an in-person payments and POS-integration product, so catalog and inventory sync is a fair question for it. The evidence covers readers, locations, offline payments, tipping, receipts and refunds, but nothing documents an item catalog or inventory counts synced across registers and channels. Third-party POS integrations and custom POS builds are adjacent workarounds, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can manage an item catalog with inventory counts that stay in sync across registers and channels
